required_observations: The initial Configure failed with teb0 Phase 1 error and a nearby Results-queue permission denial.
The same launch's control log records a later Configure reaching configured at 10:05:02 -07:00.
acceptable_hypothesis: The queue-access error may explain the initial failure; the mechanism of the later recovery is unknown.
required_unknowns: Successful data taking, event delivery, queue ownership and any repair action are not established.
Grafana, ConfigDB, live DAQ state and diagnostic history were not queried.
unsupported_claims: Configure remained failed throughout the excerpt or launch.
An operator deleted or repaired the queue.
A successful Configure establishes healthy data taking.
The initial failure can be omitted because a later retry succeeded.
incident_grouping: One initial failure followed by an observed successful retry in the same launch.
review: Human semantic review; exact wording and finding count are not required.
